why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the testnet walkthrough Go to the Knidos testnet sign-up and start the short onboarding walkthrough. You can reopen the guide later from the dashboard.
2 Step 2 : Get access with an invite code or the waitlist Access is released in waves. Enter a code on the invite page or join the waitlist .
3 Step 3 : Connect a wallet and complete your profile Link your wallet on the testnet and fill in your profile, which is the first item in the onboarding list.
4 Step 4 : Complete the onboarding missions Finish the missions to earn AP and unlock progression badges. The built-in tutorial explains how the tasks and rewards fit together.
5 Step 5 : Continue in the dashboard Use the dashboard to pick up where you left off and try the remaining testnet features.
